paper_title: Measurement of light-by-light scattering and search for axion-like particles with 2.2 nb$^{-1}$ of Pb+Pb data with the ATLAS detector
notes: ATLAS light-by-light scattering search for ALPs in Pb+Pb UPC, 2.2 nb^-1. Limits on ALP-photon coupling 1/Lambda_a range from 0.3 TeV^-1 (m_a=6 GeV) to 0.06 TeV^-1 (m_a=100 GeV), i.e. 3.0e-4 to 6.0e-5 GeV^-1. The coupling 1/Lambda_a relates to g_agamma. Only endpoint values are given in text; the full exclusion curve is in Figure 9/10 (HepData). Cross-section limits range from 70 nb (low mass) to 2 nb (high mass). Mass range 6-100 GeV converted: 6 GeV=6e9 eV, 100 GeV=1e11 eV.
